close_reason: Completed via child JMAP-z2cy.5.1 — Link.blobId field added and tested
description:
**What:** Add blobId field to the Link struct in jscalendar.rs. Draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-26 §5.3 states that for attachments, clients may set a blobId property on the Link object instead of href.

**Algorithm:**
1. In jscalendar.rs, add to Link struct:
   /// JMAP blob id; may be set instead of href for server-stored attachments
   /// (draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-26 §5.3).
   #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
   pub blob_id: Option<jmap_types::Id>,
2. Update doc comment on href to note it may be absent when blobId is set.
3. Add round-trip test: Link with blob_id set and href absent.
4. Existing Link tests must still pass.
5. Run cargo test -p jmap-calendars-types.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- Link.blob_id is Option<jmap_types::Id>.
- Wire name: blobId.
- cargo test -p jmap-calendars-types exits 0.
title: Add Link.blobId for JMAP attachment support (calendars-26 §5.3)
